summary: The MaintCourseDetailsASM file primarily handles course maintenance details within a user control environment, employing ASP.NET Web Forms structures such as FormView and DropDownList for data interaction and display. The file includes functionality to manage selections and updates related to course details, including dropdown selections, checkboxes for various settings, and service code management.
purpose: The purpose of this file is to facilitate the maintenance and configuration of course-related details in a web application, providing mechanisms for data binding, user interaction, and dynamic content display related to courses.
